summary: Two components cover REQ-001..006; IF-001 (summarize) crosses the module boundary summary.py -> report.py with a precise signature and error propagation. NFR and constraint REQ-006 have a credible approach, and the integration strategy exercises the real provider through the CLI. Only minor remarks.

checklist.item: Every requirement realised by a component

checklist.note: IF-001 signature, return keys and ValueError propagation defined
ARCH-002 -> ARCH-001 via IF-001; matches interface consumer list
REQ-006 via parser injection and stdlib only; ensure_ascii for cp949 is in REQ-004 but not in nfr_mapping (minor)
main() and python -m with real parser and summarize; fake parser only in unit tests
handled in ARCH-002; no external system needing a contract

findings.description: The architecture does not mention that report.py re-exports summarize from summary.py; consumers importing from report would depend on an undocumented path. Consider noting it in ARCH-002 or keeping consumers on scorepipe.summary.
The ASCII-only JSON output (cp949 safety) is covered by REQ-004 and AC-004-2 but not by any architecture note (json.dumps ensure_ascii in ARCH-002).
